name: Haltestellenanzeige (Display Monitor)
tagline: Displays the departure times of all stops in Germany (Display Monitor).
blurb: This app is intended for commuters who use the same stops every day.
description:
This app is intended for commuters who use the same stops every day.

A departure monitor can be created for each stop, either in the app itself or through widgets.

All stops in Germany are supported, some even with delay information

install.label: F-Droid
install.note: Adds F-Droid as an update source, so you keep getting updates.
